Container.Name: scrutiny-web
Container.Overview: Scrutiny Web Server (Hub/Spoke mode). Provides the web dashboard and API for S.M.A.R.T monitoring. Requires a separate InfluxDB instance and one or more Scrutiny collector containers. Use the omnibus template instead if you want an all-in-one deployment.

Config.Name: Auth Token
Config.Description: Shared secret for the dashboard login and for collectors. Required: the web server refuses to start without it unless web authentication is disabled. Set the same value as COLLECTOR_API_TOKEN on every collector.

Config.Name: InfluxDB Host
Config.Description: Hostname or IP of your InfluxDB instance (e.g. influxdb or 192.168.1.100). Required.

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: The web server runs as this user ID. Existing config files are changed to this owner at start. 99 is Unraid nobody.

Config.Name: Group ID
Config.Description: The web server runs as this group ID. 100 is Unraid users.

Config.Name: MQTT Enabled
Config.Description: Enable Home Assistant MQTT Discovery. Drives will auto-appear in Home Assistant.

Config.Name: MQTT Broker
Config.Description: MQTT broker URL (e.g. tcp://mosquitto:1883). Required when MQTT is enabled.
